title: Rejecting a stale write
questions: Explain expected version 7 vs stored version 8, then the matching version 7 vs 7. Show the stored value stays unchanged on rejection. The comparison and write are one database statement, not two operations.

slide.title: One atomic update rejects stale writes
slide.narrative: The client supplies the version it read. One database statement checks the document id and version and makes the change only if both match. A rejected update preserves the stored body and version. The function does not retry automatically.

fileSummaries.summary: Document updates now require a matching version and return 409 when no row changes.

mechanism.title: Does the supplied version match?
mechanism.takeaway: Expected version 7 rejects stored version 8 without a change; it updates stored version 7 to version 8.
mechanism.assumptions: These are illustrative inputs, not production measurements. Both scenarios use an existing row with the requested id.

scenarios.title: Expected 7, stored 8: reject
scenarios.input: Matching id; expected version 7; requested body B; stored body A, version 8.

events.title: The client has an old version
events.caption: The request supplies version 7, but the stored row has version 8.

events.title: The atomic UPDATE finds no matching version
events.caption: The same statement checks id and version and conditionally writes; version 8 does not match 7, so nothing changes.

events.title: Zero affected rows returns 409
events.caption: The stored body and version stay unchanged. There is no automatic retry.

scenarios.title: Expected 7, stored 7: write
scenarios.input: Matching id; expected version 7; requested body B; stored body A, version 7.

events.title: The supplied and stored versions match
events.caption: This separate example starts with stored version 7.

events.title: The atomic UPDATE writes body B and version 8
events.caption: The id and version match, so the same statement replaces the body and increases the version by one.

events.title: The successful update returns 200
events.caption: The database now stores the requested body at version 8.
